ingredients.name: polished white rice
ingredients.function: the bulk of the dish; bran and germ removed at the mill

ingredients.name: split mung dal
ingredients.function: reduced to a flavouring share rather than half the dish

ingredients.name: refined seed oil or ghee
ingredients.function: tempering fat, usually a neutral refined blend

ingredients.name: turmeric, cumin, green chilli
ingredients.function: the modern spice base; chilli in place of pepper

method_reconstructed: Boil rice and dal together with turmeric until soft.
Temper cumin and chilli in oil and stir through.
